meta.title: Daily intake (dsh-diet)
meta.description: Calculates daily carbohydrate, protein and fat targets from body weight and activity, then logs food by grams from a preset or custom library. The formula is based on the “foolproof formula” shared by Douyin creator 零重力R哥. Open it from the sidebar’s Daily intake entry; logs stay in this browser and the estimates are not medical advice.
